stories.headline: Juniper Ridge wins both doubles and loses 5-2 to Westfield Friends
stories.byline: By Dale Kreuger | Courier staff writer
body: Kevin Larue shook Levi Chesnut's hand at the net Wednesday after beating him 6-2, 7-5 at No. 4 singles. Chesnut had won his first 18 varsity matches, 16 of them as a freshman.

Westfield Friends, a 4A school from Fort Meriwether, won all five singles matches at Juniper Ridge and beat the defending 5A champions 5-2. Juniper Ridge won both doubles matches. Westfield Friends is 4-0.

Three of the five singles matches went to a third set. Deon Rennick took Maverick Kulp to a third-set tiebreak at second singles before losing 6-2, 2-6, 7-6, and Joshua Butcher lost 7-5, 3-6, 7-5 to Levi Bishop at third.
"Their four and five would play one or two for most teams we see," Okafor said.
Grayson Adkins beat Ezekiel Amoore 7-6, 6-2 at first singles, two days after Amoore came back from a set down at Liberty Hill.

Christian Pulliam and Gabriel Clark won 6-4, 4-6, 6-1 at No. 1 doubles, and freshman Dimitri Kimball and Gage McConathy won 6-2, 6-2 at No. 2. Juniper Ridge opened the Kajaani League Thursday with a 6-1 win at Cedar Exchange, where Amoore won 6-1, 6-3.
Juniper Ridge (3-1, 1-0 Kajaani) hosts Lateral Seven Friday.

stories.headline: Carroway freshmen win at No. 1 doubles in a 4-3 loss
stories.byline: By Dale Kreuger | Courier staff writer
body: Four matches went to a third set at Carroway Thursday, and Jimmy Carter of Garrow won all four to win the dual 4-3.

Senior Michael Stevens took the first set 6-3 at fifth singles and lost the next two 7-6, 7-5 to sophomore Gabriel Fong. Freshman Leo Walton at third singles and junior James Stacy at fourth also lost in three, and so did the No. 2 doubles team of Max Callender and freshman John Qin.

Luke Palm, who played almost entirely doubles last season, beat Ryan Byram 6-0, 6-3 at first singles, and Primitivo Delgado won 6-4, 6-4 at second. Freshmen Uwe Fiebich and Rashad McCloud won 6-4, 3-6, 7-5 at No. 1 doubles in their second varsity dual.
Carroway (1-1) beat Pacersburg 7-0 the day before and opens the Juniper League Friday at Ostrander Union.
"Every one of those went three sets," Haverkamp said. "We were up a set in three of them."

stories.headline: Notebook: Calder wins its league opener in doubles
body: Calder. It beat Obama 4-3 Wednesday in the Fiesta Athletic Association opener while losing first and second singles. Calder won three of the four doubles matches, and senior Luis Atteberry won the fourth point at third singles, 6-0, 6-4. Calder hosts Liberty Hill Friday; Liberty Hill (2-2) lost its league opener 6-1 at Tidewater Catholic Thursday.

Fairgrounds. Freshman Damien Paquette has played first singles in all three of the team's duals. Against Las Colinas he lost the first set 6-0 to senior Alex Kunkel and won the next two 6-4, 6-3. Fairgrounds still lost 4-3 and is 2-1.
Senator Gray. It won at Bitterroot (6-1) and Ditch Fork (5-2) after Monday's 7-0 loss to Altamonte. Cranston Diggins beat Joshua Cater 6-4, 5-7, 7-6 at first singles at Bitterroot.
High Desert Christian. It beat Cornerstone Christian 4-3 Tuesday for its first dual win of the season and lost to Trinity Catholic by the same score Wednesday.
Mt Jacqueline. It won 4-3 at Copper Gap Tuesday and lost 7-0 at Mabryville Wednesday.
Copper Gap and Marlow County. Both won their league openers 6-1, Copper Gap over Aspen Hollow and Marlow County over Archbishop Quinlan.

stories.headline: Friday's league duals
body: Carroway is at Ostrander Union in the Juniper League, Juniper Ridge hosts Lateral Seven and Calder hosts Liberty Hill. Covenant is at Mission Terrace, Navrang hosts Box Canyon and Trout Lake hosts Seamus Town.
